paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge across during tokenization training different number of tokens.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the Macro-F1 scores of two models, MATTER and w/o material information, across different numbers of tokens. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)", has a linear scale ranging from 48 to 58, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens", has a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.5, with irregular tick labels. The plot contains two lines: one pink line with circle markers and a solid line style representing MATTER, and one purple line with circle markers and a solid line style representing w/o material information. The pink line starts at approximately 55.5% at 0.5 tokens and ends at approximately 51% at 1.5 tokens, with a peak at around 58% at 1.0 tokens. The purple line starts at approximately 53% at 0.5 tokens and ends at approximately 48.5% at 1.5 tokens.
